description: This file defines the EntityAccess class for handling entity access control hooks within the Drupal workspaces module, including methods for access checks and permissions related to workspace entities.

classes.name: EntityAccess
classes.description: Handles entity access control hooks for workspaces, including entity creation and deletion permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for entity type management, workspace management, and workspace info.

methods.name: entityAccess
methods.description: Checks access for entity operations, especially deletion, based on workspace support and entity status.

methods.name: entityCreateAccess
methods.description: Checks access for creating entities within supported workspaces.

methods.name: bypassAccessResult
methods.description: Determines if a user can bypass access restrictions based on workspace ownership and permissions.
